I'm also having this issue, which was supposed to be fixed in https://github.com/symfony/symfony/pull/35423 I opened vendor/symfony/web-profiler-bundle/Resources/views/Collector/cache.html.twig and changed it to round(2) ``` --- vendor/symfony/web-profiler-bundle/Resources/views/Collector/cache.html.twig +++ vendor/symfony/web-profiler-bundle/Resources/views/Collector/cache.html.twig @@ -108,7 +108,7 @@
{% if key == 'time' %} - {{ '%0.2f'|format(1000 * value) }} ms + {{ (1000 * value)|round(2) }} ms {% elseif key == 'hit_read_ratio' %} {{ value ?? 0 }} % {% else %} ```

Same issue here. 
@arcticlinux solution work for me.

manually deleting your cache will fixe the issue
go to [your-project]/code/var/cache/
delete all (linux :  rm -fr *)
